var_protocol_note: This file contains only VAR-reviewable decisions according to FIFA/IFAB protocol: Goals, Penalties, Red Cards, and Mistaken Identity. Yellow cards and other non-VAR incidents are excluded.

var_decision.note: Lionel Messi (Argentina) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Mostafa Shobeir anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Egypt players look gutted.
